definition: One-dimensional diffusion-reaction model of ALD growth in a lateral channel with reversible Langmuir adsorption; the reactant pressure uses a closed-form approximation and the surface coverage (Eq. 31) is solved numerically (4th-order Runge-Kutta; ODE23 in Yim 2020) (Ylilammi 2018, Secs. III-V; listed as analytical in Cremers 2019, Sec. V A 1).
Analytical model based on conductance formulae in which the reactant enters as a front and reacts on first collision with an unsaturated wall (Cremers 2019, Sec. V A 1).
Markov chain model in which the trajectory of a molecule is a series of transitions between positions in the feature, with sticking and recombination probabilities (Cremers 2019, Sec. V B 2).
Closed-form relation between the slope of the normalized thickness profile at half coverage and the sticking coefficient, valid in the Knudsen regime (Yim 2020, Sec. D, citing Arts 2019 Eq. 3).
